title: Comprehensive Care for AYA: Needs Assessment Survey
official: Comprehensive Care for AYA: Needs Assessment Survey
summary:
The goal of this observational study is to assess gaps in education about exercise, sexual health, fertility, survivorship, financial issues, interpersonal relationships, and clinical trial participation among adolescents and young adults with cancer.

Participants will be asked to complete a series of questionnaires.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals diagnosed with cancer between the ages of 15-39 per self-report. Participants may be enrolled at any age provided diagnosis was between ages 15-39.
* Individuals who have received or are receiving cancer-directed treatment (chemotherapy, immunotherapy, surgery and/or radiation) at one of the participating centers per self-report.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe emotional distress or anxiety that would limit compliance with study requirements per self-report.

sites.f: Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Comprehensive Cancer Center
